_comment: BEST-EFFORT TikTok Shop product_id → Bloop catalog SKU map. TikTok product IDs are not in the Bloop catalog (assets/products.js) and this repo has no stronger TikTok↔SKU source. Assignments were inferred from review wording: numbing cream → Lido Creams SKUs D26 / D30 / D33 / D46 / D47; eye patches → D3 / D8; face mask → D12; a nebulizer/saline mention → D25. Confidence is medium or low for most cream IDs, because several numbing creams share similar review language. The live site reads window.TIKTOK_SKU_MAP in assets/tiktok-sku-map.js. To move a product's reviews onto a different Bloop SKU, change that product's "sku" in assets/tiktok-sku-map.js AND in this file (keep them identical), then bump the ?v= cache-bust on the HTML pages. Do not delete product ids — every exported TikTok product_id is listed so all 301 reviews stay on the site. Do not invent reviewer names or review text. Fields: sku (Bloop catalog SKU such as D47), name_hint (why this guess was made), confidence (high, medium, or low).
